whatIsIt.eli5: A volume knob that needs no learning: it turns up spots that stand out from their surroundings.
whatIsIt.simple: Computes, for every value, how much it differs from its channel's average (an energy function) and uses that as a gate. No parameters.
whatIsIt.engineer: Closed-form energy per neuron → σ → scale; zero params.

whyExists.eli5: Things that stand out are often what we look for.
whyExists.simple: Adds attention without any learned weights, so pretrained weights stay usable and cost is tiny.

eli5: Compare each spot with the average.
Spots that stand out are turned up.
simple: Distance of each value from its channel mean, normalised by the variance.

costNote.simple: No parameters; small compute. Needs the parse_model edit.
